annotation_rules.project_semantics: Named actual initiative/product family with dedicated primary-purpose evidence; no forced Project for independent repository.
annotation_rules.no_project: No supported registry Project; may still have supported Topics or Tags. UNKNOWN membership is not a negative label.
annotation_rules.global_no_match: No supported assignment in any allowed kind under the frozen registry; must be assessed separately, never inferred from noProject.
annotation_rules.primary_topics_and_tags: Use primary purpose/capability and primary implementation technologies; do not label every dependency or optional deployment tool.
annotation_rules.supplemental_evidence: Record whether relationship support is in README/app-profile/compact-prompt or only in supporting files; do not silently make classifier input richer than application input.
annotation_rules.contradictions: Preserve explicit exclusions, stale statements, ambiguity and source disagreements.
annotation_rules.leakage_controls: Keep annotation/search explanations out of classifier input; group related initiatives/copied source lineages in a single split; registry-source overlap disclosed.
annotation_rules.ground_truth_gate: Human approval required; machine/agent proposals are not ground truth.
